doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: Playing for presidents with Sinatra and Goodman
summary: Bucky recalls playing for Reagan and for Italy's president Pertini with Sinatra, and an Italian medley with Tony Mottola.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What would have impressed, let’s say during the years where most of your kids were like junior high age. Was there anything you were doing that would impress them?

Well we played for the president, a couple of presidents. And it was with Reagan first with Sinatra and with Benny Goodman, Buddy Rich playing drums, Milt Hinton, Hank Jones on piano. And then another one was with —
The president of Italy. He was a guest. So Tony Mottola and I got together and we made up an Italian medley. And that was big. I have a picture of that, a movie of it.
